children: ICICI Securities's research report on Entero Healthcare Solutions

Entero reported a strong operating performance in Q2FY27, with revenue/EBITDA/PAT growing 32.9%/78.3%/ 44.1% YoY. Organic growth of 18% continues to be well ahead of pharma market, and management believes it has enough levers in business to ensure this growth run-rate. EBITDA margin improvement of 140bps YoY to 5.3% was fuelled by cost discipline across segments and a rise in contribution from the Medtech business. Post a robust H1FY27, management anticipates that Entero may surpass its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 23%. The company is expected to generate >INR 2bn in operating cash flows in FY27, which may be deployed towards boosting growth through M&A or increasing its stake in subsidiaries that are not fully owned. Retain BUY and TP of INR 2,100 (17x FY28E EV/EBITDA).

At CMP the stock trades at 42.6x FY27E and 30.3x FY28E earnings and 18.1x FY28E and 13.8x FY28E EV/EBITDA. We maintain BUY with an unchanged target price of INR 2,100, valuing the company at 17x FY28E EV/EBITDA (unchanged).
